scope: F1 one-submission business-rule demonstration for the Thursday stand-up. This is not a Camunda deployment, real certification check, persistent product store, or complete food-information compliance validator.

reviewPlan.JiaqiXie: Review F1 business paths and publication contract
reviewPlan.JilongCheng: Review configured form fields, preview results, validation rules and test cases

implementation.call: evaluate_listing(details: dict, business_date: str, verification_outcome: str | None = None) -> dict
implementation.businessDate: Explicit strict YYYY-MM-DD date string supplied by caller; no wall clock or timezone inference
implementation.invocationErrors: Non-dict details, invalid business_date or unsupported verification_outcome raise ValueError. These are not producer certificate errors.
implementation.unknownFields: Ignored and not copied into the output product.

formProposal.status: Both Forms are created in Camunda and associated with F1_Submit/F1_Edit. All three project Forms show Problems 0. Runtime mappings still require process-instance verification.
previewChecked: Organic claim exposes required certification reference
Dynamic allergen entry can be added
Correction shows original input and validationErrors
Corrected certificate reference appears in preview output
formProposal.actualFormDataShape: Form field keys use details.<field>; allergenEntries is a list of {name}. Task output mapping normalizes that list to details.allergens and omits empty optional fields. Engine execution of mappings remains unverified.

fields.proposedRule: Non-blank string; no category catalogue implemented
Numeric int/float, finite and >= 0; reject bool and numeric strings. No artificial maximum or currency precision limit.
fields.policyStatus: Nonnegative price and JSON numeric shape are review proposals, not an exact official field constraint.

fields.proposedRule: Whole units >= 0; reject bool, floats and numeric strings
fields.policyStatus: Integer units are the shared prototype representation; weighted/fractional units remain unresolved.

fields.proposedRule: Non-blank string; location evidence not checked
If supplied, must be a boolean; true activates the certification path
Non-blank reference text; exact reference format and evidence checks unimplemented
fields.policyStatus: The reference field and conditional presence rule are proposed form choices. A reference is not evidence of a valid certificate.

fields.proposedRule: If supplied, must be strict YYYY-MM-DD
fields.coverage: Format only; category-specific applicability and chronology are NOT implemented

fields.proposedRule: If supplied, list of non-blank strings; [] passes this shape check
fields.coverage: List shape only; completeness, recognised allergens and category-specific declarations are NOT implemented

fields.proposedRule: If supplied, must be strict YYYY-MM-DD
fields.coverage: Format only; applicability, expiry/sale restrictions and relation to harvest date are NOT implemented

providerSimulation.noClaim: Bypass provider outcome; publication can follow field validation.

trueClaim.verified: Publish only after basic field validation; this injected string is trusted for demonstration and does not prove evidence was checked.
trueClaim.invalid: Remain unpublished; return correction_required with certification_invalid, following F1_Result -> Gateway_1tq8q8b -> F1_Correction -> F1_Edit.
trueClaim.unavailable: Remain unpublished; verification_pending, errors [], followUpRequired true. This includes an upstream adapter's timeout mapped to unavailable and must not be changed to invalid.
trueClaim.null: Remain unpublished while waiting at F1_Verify; pendingReason awaiting_verification, followUpRequired false.

providerSimulation.adapterLimit: No timeout detector, connector, retry scheduling, follow-up recording or notification delivery is implemented.

properties.status: Business-rule result only; published means the local publication branch was selected.
properties.product: Null if basic validation fails; otherwise a new normalised draft/product dict. Includes published, available, name, description, category, price, quantity, startDate, endDate, farmOrigin and organicClaim; supplied supported optional fields are copied. No product identity or durable write is created.
properties.errors: List of {field, code, message}. Provider outages do not produce an invalid-certificate input error.
properties.followUpRequired: True only for the provider-unavailable branch; no follow-up is actually saved.
properties.nextNode: Suggested BPMN handoff/wait node, not a running engine token.
properties.trace: Conceptual BPMN node path for review; not evidence that tasks or notifications executed.

output.availabilityRule: published AND quantity > 0 AND startDate <= business_date <= endDate
output.publicationVsSale: A validated zero-stock, future-dated or expired-period product can be published while available is false.
output.resubmission: Call the function again with corrected details; validation repeats from the entry path. There is no stored waiting process or linked request history.

limitations: Producer registration/authentication and ownership are preconditions only; no login/session or permission checks.

Food-specific applicability, mandatory allergen completeness, harvest/best-before chronology and certificate issuer/scope/expiry/evidence are not fully validated. A published demo result must not be read as a complete compliance decision.
Exact price/currency policies, fractional stock units, allowed category catalogue and timezone/business-date policy need group review.
Forms are created, linked and preview-checked, but there is no real provider call, deployed Camunda process/Form, connector, worker or executable gateway expression.
No database, product identifier allocation, atomic persistence, idempotency, concurrency protection or integration with real F2/order processing.
No actual producer notifications, retry/reminder/cancellation or follow-up scheduling.
The saved diagram and repository notes do not constitute tutor approval; this draft asserts no tutor confirmation or individual student completion.

scenarios: Valid non-organic submission -> published and available
Claim plus simulated unavailable -> verification_pending, unpublished

checks.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_f1.py -v
checks.scope: Local standard-library business-path checks, not deployed-engine or real-provider tests
